# David Fayemi

> UK-based Senior Product Designer specializing in fintech and design systems. At LemFi, David leads design for the credit suite and the next-gen design system, building credit products that include the people the system was never built for.

## About

I'm a senior product designer who builds financial products for people the system was never built for. I care about making them feel clear, trustworthy, and accessible to communities mainstream finance overlooks.

Fintech is where I've spent most of my career: remittance, credit, lending, and banking for markets where trust and clarity matter most.

At LemFi I lead design for the credit suite and our next-gen design system, including extending our tooling into AI workflows so teams ship on-brand work faster.

I also host The BluePrint Series, published Road Guide to Design Systems, and mentor designers through communities like Roadtrip and HNG.

## Selected work

- [LemFi Credit](https://davidfayemi.com/work/lemfi-credit.html): Lead designer of LemFi's four regulated UK credit products — an instalment card, Send Now Pay Later, Credit Monitor, and a revolving card. 16K+ users onboarded in the first year. Send Now Pay Later carries 60% of UK credit-line spend; 75% of credit customers have used it.
- Button Tracker (LemFi, 2026): Internal tool that makes Figma a source of truth for analytics, bridging data, design, and engineering. 80–85% of engineering tracking requirements automated.
- [Rayna UI](https://templates.raynaui.com/): Co-built open-source design system for global creators. 10K+ downloads of v1.
- Zazuu (2022): Diaspora money-movement product. 100K users saving ~7% per transfer by designing out hidden fees.
- [Bele](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VV0CweXQllo): Zazuu's design system, unifying the product with an African visual identity.
- [Renmoney](https://renmoney.com/): Digital banking app — loans, savings, payments. 5M+ Nigerians served.
- SmileMoney (Renmoney, 2021): First merchant POS product for mobile money agents (0→1).
